01 / CEFR BENCHMARK

A universal framework, used conservatively.

My current evidence supports B1 overall, with growing B2-level indicators in guided grammar, writing and structured technical communication.

A1Basic
A2Elementary
B1Current evidence
B2Next milestone
C1Advanced
C2Mastery
CURRENT WORKING ESTIMATE

B1 overall · progressing toward B2

Observed strengths include structured sentence building, technical vocabulary, modal verbs and modal expressions, and increasingly accurate written responses.

WHY NOT C1/C2 YET?

C1/C2 require consistently spontaneous performance across listening, spoken interaction, spoken production, reading and writing. Current practice data does not yet justify that claim.

Reference framework: Council of Europe CEFR. This is a working estimate, not a formal certification.

02 / PRACTICE METRICS

Accuracy by learning dimension.

These are tracked practice estimates, not standardized-exam scores. The dashboard is data-driven so it can be updated as new exercises are completed.

03 / LEARNING COVERAGE

What I have practiced.

The learning plan combines grammar foundations with real technical communication used in interviews, meetings and software-engineering discussions.

GRAMMAR

Core structures

  • Present, past and future forms
  • Present perfect vs past
  • Modal verbs and modal expressions
  • Comparatives and superlatives
  • Relative pronouns and tag questions
ACCURACY

Sentence mechanics

  • Articles: a, an, the
  • Prepositions: in, on, at, by, before, after
  • Pronouns and contractions
  • Connectors and sentence linking
  • Question structure and auxiliaries
PROFESSIONAL ENGLISH

Technical communication

  • Recruiter calls and interviews
  • Architecture and system-design vocabulary
  • Leadership and mentoring examples
  • Production incidents and troubleshooting
  • Short professional messages and follow-ups
NEXT MILESTONE

From guided to spontaneous

  • Faster sentence formation without hints
  • Longer spoken answers
  • Listening at natural speaking speed
  • Phrasal verbs in context
  • B2-style spontaneous interaction

04 / METHODOLOGY

Evidence over labels.

This page distinguishes course level, exercise performance and CEFR proficiency so the signal remains useful and honest for recruiters.

01Practice accuracy+

Percentages come from repeated exercises covering grammar, modal verbs, modal expressions, articles, prepositions, vocabulary and sentence structure.

TRACKED PRACTICE · NOT A CERTIFICATION
02CEFR estimate+

The working CEFR estimate is mapped conservatively against CEFR descriptors and should be validated with a standardized test for formal use.

A1 · A2 · B1 · B2 · C1 · C2
03No invented peer percentile+

I do not publish a “better than X% of students” claim without a reliable comparison dataset. The benchmark here is CEFR, not an invented student ranking.

TRANSPARENT BENCHMARKING
04Recruiter validation+

For international roles, the strongest validation remains a real conversation. This dashboard shows learning consistency and measured progress before that live assessment.

WRITING · SPEAKING · LISTENING · INTERACTION
